purpose: Qualify deterministic, crash-safe multi-pod CPU generation before authorizing any S4 production shard.

candidate_physical_packing.note: Packing may be changed only after this canary; trajectory seeds, protocols, split counts and S4 transition counts may not be changed by a packing decision.

required_experiments: Generate the same planned shard on two independent hosts in separate output roots with the same global worker index and seed; require identical validated HDF5 SHA-256.
Launch the same global worker index twice against one shared output; require the second process to refuse before touching an HDF5 partial.
Kill one worker during a partial shard, confirm its stale claims, explicitly recover only after the old pod is stopped, and require the regenerated shard to match the independent reference hash.
Run disjoint global worker ranges concurrently on one shared network volume; require exact coverage with no duplicate shard indices, failures or physical mismatches.
Measure background and targeted aggregate throughput at local concurrency 8 and 16 with BLAS/OpenMP threads fixed to one.

acceptance_gates.concurrency_selection_rule: Choose the fastest stable aggregate transitions/s per dollar; reject a level that produces failures, materially worse throughput, or memory pressure.

production_authorization: S4 production planning remains blocked until every canary gate passes and the selected packing and concurrency are recorded in a separate sealed result.
